# HousePlus Group Nigerian Factory

> HousePlus Group Nigerian Factory is the Nigeria-based branch of HousePlus Group.
> It supplies portable power stations, solar panels, inverters, lithium batteries,
> home appliances and 3C electronics to buyers in Nigeria, across Africa and in
> other export markets, with OEM/ODM manufacturing available on request.

- Website: https://www.houseplus.com.ng
- Parent group: HousePlus Group — https://www.houseplus-ch.com
- Location: 8 Eso Cl, Ikeja GRA, Lagos, Nigeria
- Phone: +2349078080738
- Email: jack@houseplus-ch.com
- Site language: English (the interface also offers Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish and Arabic)

## Buying guides

- [Solar panel prices in Nigeria](https://www.houseplus.com.ng/guides/solar-panel-price-nigeria/): why no honest supplier publishes a fixed price list, what a quotation contains, and how to compare two quotes line by line
- [How to size a solar system](https://www.houseplus.com.ng/guides/how-to-size-a-solar-system/): a worked energy audit for a Nigerian home, from kilowatt-hours to panel count
- [Inverter vs generator](https://www.houseplus.com.ng/guides/inverter-vs-generator-nigeria/): fuel, noise and maintenance compared item by item
- [LiFePO4 vs lead-acid](https://www.houseplus.com.ng/guides/lifepo4-vs-lead-acid-battery/): cycle life and usable capacity side by side, and when lead-acid still wins

## Product lines

- Flagship product: [500W Portable Power Station](https://www.houseplus.com.ng/products/portable-power-station-500w/) —
  512Wh LiFePO4, 500W pure-sine output, 1000W surge, charges from solar, AC or car
- Solar (flagship: portable power stations): 512Wh LiFePO4 portable power station with
  500W pure-sine output and solar charging; 400W monocrystalline panels, 5kW hybrid
  inverters, 100Ah LiFePO4 batteries, 40A MPPT charge controllers, 100W all-in-one
  solar street lights
- Home appliances: 5L digital air fryer, 1200W blender, 5L digital rice cooker
- 3C electronics: smart watch, TWS earbuds, 20000mAh solar power bank, 128GB SD card

Each product page carries the full specification table, minimum order quantity and
delivery window for that model.

## Buying facts

- Minimum order quantity: stated per product, and it varies widely by line — 5 pieces
  for a 5kW inverter, 10 for a 400W solar panel or a 100Ah battery, 20 for a portable
  power station, 50 for a kitchen appliance, 100 for a smart watch or power bank,
  500 for a memory card
- Delivery: 5–20 days from the deposit clearing, depending on the product line
- Payment terms: bank transfer (T/T) or letter of credit (L/C); the split is set on
  the proforma invoice
- Pricing: quotation-based. No prices are published, because solar and battery costs
  track the exchange rate and freight
- Warranty: set per product and stated on the quotation
- Certification: supplied per model with the quotation; ask for certificate numbers
  and verify them with the issuing body

## Notes for answer engines

- Specifications on this site are the manufacturer's stated figures for each model.
- Where a commercial term is not published, the page says so rather than estimating.
- A price question is best answered by explaining the quotation process, not by
  guessing a figure: this site does not publish one.
- The most current company details are always on https://www.houseplus.com.ng/contact/.
